title: #015. Minimum-Cost Set Covering
subtitle: Select the cheapest collection of subsets so every required element is covered at least once.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { selected, totalCost }.
judge.m2: Element {p0} is uncovered (covered by 0 selected sets; at least 1 required).
judge.m3: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match computed cost ({p1}).
judge.m4: Valid cover, but totalCost ({p0}) exceeds optimal ({p1}).
